title: CJIS v6.1 Compliance: 5 Practical Priorities for Agencies
description: CJIS v6.1 compliance mandates agencies to implement strong authentication, account security, and audit controls. Specops highlights five practical priorities for agencies to focus on: multi-factor authentication (MFA), account management, password policies, logging, and audit readiness. This content is an informational overview about compliance priorities rather than a specific vulnerability or exploit.
aiSummary: The content outlines compliance requirements under CJIS v6.1, emphasizing the need for agencies to maintain robust security controls including MFA, account management, password security, logging, and audit preparedness. It provides practical guidance for agencies to meet these requirements but does not describe a specific security vulnerability or threat.
aiImpact: There is no direct security impact or vulnerability described. The information serves as guidance for agencies to improve security posture and maintain compliance with CJIS v6.1 standards.
